title: helianthemum chamaecistus var. serpillifolium
intro: Helianthemum chamaecistus var. serpillifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat wounds, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
